Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**SAPPHIRE FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (gem), lawful neutral*
**AC** 22 (natural armor)
**HP** 370 (20d20 + 160)
**Speed** 60 ft., burrow 60 ft., climb 60 ft., fly 120 ft.
**STR** 30 (+10) | **DEX** 17 (+3) | **CON** 27 (+8) | **INT** 25 (+7) | **WIS** 22 (+6) | **CHA** 23 (+6)
**Saving Throws** Dex +11, Con +16, Wis +14, Cha +14
**Skills** History +15, Perception +20, Persuasion +14, Stealth +11
**Resistances** lightning
**Immunities** thunder
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 30
**Languages** Common, Draconic, telepathy 240 ft.
**CR** 25 (75,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +8

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic, spider climb*

***Innate Spellcasting.*** The dragon’s spellcasting ability is Intelligence. It can cast the following spells, requiring no spell components:
• ***At will:*** read thoughts
• ***2/Day each:*** dissonant whispers
• ***1/Day each:*** hold monster, meld into stone, telekinesis, teleport

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

***Tunneler.*** The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and can leave a 20-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

***Uncanny Resonance.*** Thunder damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to thunder damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) thunder damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options:
• ***Beckoning Scream.*** The dragon condenses a mind-numbing burst of sound, which it exhales at a point it can see within 300 feet where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. All creatures within range must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 78 (12d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Overwhelming Scream.*** The dragon unleashes a scream that echoes out, overwhelming the senses of all creatures within 120 feet of it. Each creature in range must succeed a DC 24 Constitution saving throw or take 28 (5d10) thunder damage and become stunned. Creatures stunned this way can repeat the save at the end of each of their turns and each time they take damage, ending the effect on a success.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

***Psychic Step.*** The dragon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 90 feet.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Weave (Recharge 5-6).*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Silent Shell.*** When the dragon sees a creature speak or perform verbal components within 60 feet of it, they can surround that creature in a sphere of silence until the end of the turn. In the sphere no sound can be produced, causing creatures to be deafened and preventing verbal components from being performed. If this ability was triggered by a spell, the spell is not cast and the action is wasted, but the spell slot/use and material components are not. This sphere surrounds the target in a 10 foot radius and remains centered on the space the creature was standing in. If the creature moves out of the sphere it explodes in a blast of noise, forcing the creature to succeed a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 20 (3d12) thunder damage.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Psychic Step (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon uses its Psychic Step or casts a spell through its Innate Spellcasting.
***Telekinetic Fling (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon chooses one Large or smaller object that isn’t being worn or carried that it can see within 90 feet and magically hurls that object at a creature it can see within 90 feet of the object. The target must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 39 (7d10) bludgeoning damage and 17 (3d10) thunder damage.
